default-response.parameter-map: {name:name, west:west, south:south, east:east, north:north, minZoom:minZoom, maxZoom:maxZoom, profileId:profileId}

error-response.parameter-map: {name:name, west:west, south:south, east:east, north:north, minZoom:minZoom, maxZoom:maxZoom, profileId:profileId}

if.script: ec.message.addMessage(updated.applied ? ec.l10n.localize('The offline map is being built again: its earlier file stays until the new one is ready') : updated.reason, updated.applied ? 'success' : 'warning')
ec.message.addMessage(cancelled.applied ? ec.l10n.localize('The build stops at its next batch of tiles') : cancelled.reason, cancelled.applied ? 'success' : 'warning')
ec.message.addMessage(deleted.applied ? ec.l10n.localize('Offline map deleted: a copy on a device stays there until it is deleted there') : deleted.reason, deleted.applied ? 'success' : 'warning')

set.from: Array.from(found?.packageList || []).map(row => Object.assign({}, row, {stateText: row.statusText + (row.busy && row.progress != null ? ' ' + row.progress + '%' : '') + (row.statusNote ? ' · ' + row.statusNote : '')}))

Record layers and a provider's own tiles are not packaged. A package on a device stays readable there until it is deleted there.
